test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Anaimudi, the highest peak in South India, is located at the tri-junction of which three hill ranges?

options.text: Nilgiri Hills, Western Ghats, Eastern Ghats
Rajmahal Hills, Garo Hills, Khasi Hills
Annamalai Range, Cardamom Hills, Palani Hills
Mahadeo Hills, Maikala Range, Rajpipla Hills

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Annamalai Range, Cardamom Hills, Palani Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anaimudi** is the **highest peak in South India**, with an elevation of **2,695 meters (8,842 feet)** above sea level.
 
• It is located in the **Western Ghats** mountain range in the state of **Kerala**, India.
 
• The peak lies at the **tri-junction of three major hill ranges**: **Annamalai Range**, **Cardamom Hills**, and **Palani Hills**.
 
• The name "Anaimudi" translates to "**Elephant's Forehead**" in Tamil and Malayalam, reflecting the shape of the peak.
 
• The region surrounding Anaimudi is home to the **Eravikulam National Park**, which is known for its rich biodiversity, including the **Nilgiri Tahr**, an endangered species of mountain goat.
 
• Anaimudi is a significant destination for **trekking enthusiasts** and offers breathtaking views of the lush greenery and tea plantations of the Western Ghats.
 
• The peak is also an important part of the **UNESCO World Heritage-listed Western Ghats**, recognized for its ecological and cultural significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nilgiri Hills, Western Ghats, Eastern Ghats**__

 __
 
• The **Nilgiri Hills** are part of the **Western Ghats**, located in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka. However, Anaimudi is not situated at the tri-junction of these ranges.
 
• The **Eastern Ghats** are a discontinuous range of mountains along the eastern coast of India, distinct from the Western Ghats.
 
 
 
• **Rajmahal Hills, Garo Hills, Khasi Hills**__
 __
 
• The **Rajmahal Hills** are located in Jharkhand, and the **Garo Hills** and **Khasi Hills** are in Meghalaya in northeastern India.
 
• These hills are not related to the location of Anaimudi or the Western Ghats.
 
 
 
• **Mahadeo Hills, Maikala Range, Rajpipla Hills**__
 
 
• The **Mahadeo Hills** are located in Madhya Pradesh, while the **Maikala Range** is in Chhattisgarh, and the **Rajpipla Hills** are in Gujarat.
 
• These ranges are not part of the Western Ghats or associated with Anaimudi.
